rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something memorable or not easily forgotten, including a haunting gaze.

example.traditional: 嗰場演唱會真係令人難忘。
example.jyutping: go2 coeng4 jin2 coeng3 wui2 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 naan4 mong4

rows.note: Use this when the haunting quality is an image, feeling, or memory that lingers and cannot be shaken off.

example.english: The haunting image of that accident has stayed with me.
example.traditional: 嗰幕意外嘅畫面一直揮之不去。
example.jyutping: go2 mok6 ji3 ngoi6 ge3 waa2 min2 jat1 zik6 fai1 zi1 bat1 heoi3
